# Switch (`switch`)

On/off switch and the settings toggle row.

Group: Choice & range. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/choice-inputs';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createSwitch` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/switch.d.ts`): `.mh-switch` (`--row` for the settings toggle row): a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`, so Space toggles it and screen readers announce on/off. The track takes the control radius, so square corners give a square switch.

```ts
export function createSwitch(options: SwitchOptions): SwitchHandle;

export interface SwitchOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** A second line under the label (announced as the description). */
  description?: string;
  checked?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** The settings toggle row: label (and icon) at the start, the switch at the end, full width. */
  row?: boolean;
  /** A leading icon in the row. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  name?: string;
  onChange?: (checked: boolean, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface SwitchHandle {
  el: HTMLLabelElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  isChecked(): boolean;
  setChecked(checked: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createSwitch } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const motion = createSwitch({
  row: true,
  icon: 'lightbulb',
  label: 'Motion lighting',
  description: 'Turn the lights on when someone walks in.',
  checked: true,
  onChange: (on) => afterSunset.setDisabled(!on),
});

const afterSunset = createSwitch({ row: true, icon: 'weather', label: 'Only after sunset' });

document.body.append(motion.el, afterSunset.el);
```

## React API

`Switch` (types in `dist/react/choice-inputs.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createSwitch`: `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`.

```ts
export function Switch({ label, description, row, icon, className, ...rest }: SwitchProps);

export interface SwitchProps extends NativeCheckbox {
  label?: ReactNode;
  description?: ReactNode;
  /** The settings toggle row: label at the start, switch at the end. */
  row?: boolean;
  icon?: IconName | string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Switch } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SwitchExample() {
  const [motion, setMotion] = useState(true);
  const [afterSunset, setAfterSunset] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div>
      <Switch
        row
        icon="lightbulb"
        label="Motion lighting"
        description="Turn the lights on when someone walks in."
        checked={motion}
        onChange={(e) => setMotion(e.target.checked)}
      />
      <Switch
        row
        icon="weather"
        label="Only after sunset"
        checked={afterSunset}
        disabled={!motion}
        onChange={(e) => setAfterSunset(e.target.checked)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
